claims.text: Newborn blood screening: confirm the initial screen was done, verify results and follow up. The Recommended Uniform Screening Panel and state newborn screening laws set which conditions are screened.
claims.quote: 19. Confirm initial screen was accomplished, verify results, and follow up, as appropriate. The Recommended Uniform Screening Panel (https://www.hrsa.gov/ advisory-committees/heritable-disorders/rusp/index.html), as determined by The Secretary's Advisory Committee on Heritable Disorders in Newborns and Children, and state newborn screening laws/regulations (https://www.babysfirsttest.org/) establish the criteria for and coverage of newborn screening procedures and programs.
